subject: Pre-approval: Regional Workshop — expedited PO & cost coding
message_1_subject: Pre-approval: Regional Workshop — expedited PO & cost coding
message_1_body:
Hi Laura / Kim,

Quick one — we need a fast approval to issue an expedited PO for our May 20 FinServe regional workshop in Denver. Acme Events (copied) is holding the venue with a non-refundable deposit and asked for payment by next Friday to lock the date.

Summary: 
- Event: FinServe regional workshop (customer-facing, ~75 attendees)
- Deposit required: $9,500 (non-refundable)
- Estimated total spend: $28,400 (venue + A/V + catering + on-site staff)
- Current spend ceiling for this region: $15,000 -> needs to be raised to $30,000 for this event

Asks: 
1) Can Finance provisionally approve an expedited PO or PCard payment for the deposit ($9,500) this week so we don't lose the date?
2) Confirm cost center / FOAPAL to code to — marketing asked MKT-REG-WORKSHOP but we need exact accounting string.
3) If PO is required, can we get a PO number by Friday 5/6? We can route the signed SOW (attached) and venue quote to Accounts Payable.

Attachments: acme_venue_quote_0427.pdf (quote), regional_workshop_sow_0427.pdf (SOW).

Kim — can you confirm if PCard can be used for the deposit or whether AP needs a PO?

Sophie — appreciate any flexibility on the deposit timing if we can get provisional approval this week; we will follow up with the signed SOW/DocuSign immediately.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0129
message_2_subject: Re: Pre-approval: Regional Workshop — expedited PO & cost coding
message_2_body:
Hi Tessa / Laura / Kim,

Thanks for the heads-up. We can hold the venue for 72 hours without payment, but to guarantee May 20 we need the deposit by Friday 5/6. I've attached a pro forma deposit invoice (acme_invoice_deposit_0428.pdf).

If Redwood prefers a PO, please send the PO reference and we will issue an invoice against it. If paying by card, we can process a virtual card or accept ACH — whichever is faster for you.

I've also attached the updated SOW which includes a clause for onsite assistant staffing and hybrid streaming setup. If anything needs to be redlined, let me know ASAP so we can keep the timeline.

Best,
Sophie Delgado
Senior Event Producer, Acme Events
Attachments: acme_invoice_deposit_0428.pdf, regional_workshop_sow_0427.pdf
message_3_subject: Re: Pre-approval: Regional Workshop — expedited PO & cost coding
message_3_body:
Tessa — thanks for the clear summary.

We can provisionally approve the deposit payment of $9,500 to hold the venue, provided you supply: 
1) Final FOAPAL / cost center string to post to (see below)
2) Signed SOW or DocuSign envelope id so AP has approval documentation
3) Confirmation whether you want AP to issue a PO or if you will charge the PCard (note: PCard limit for field events is $10k without a plus-up; we can request an exception but it'll take 48 hours to process).

Proposed coding (please confirm):
- Cost center: MKT-REG-DENVER
- Project: EVNT-2027-0420
- GL account: 6502 (Events & Sponsorships)

If you confirm the above and sign the SOW via DocuSign, AP will issue an expedited PO (PO# 2027-ENV-0789) and we can route the deposit invoice to Accounts Payable for payment this week.

Tessa — can you confirm whether you want the PO route or to push the PCard exception? If PO, I'll ask AP to prioritize and confirm PO# within 24 hours of receiving the signed SOW.

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
